text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby didn't show up for training. 
While searching around for her with 
worry...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry for not being able to 
make it to training.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I cannot tell you, as the reason pertains 
to confidential matters of the family.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Saying something like this will inevitably 
make me lose your trust. That is precisely 
why—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I intend to devote myself even more than 
ever in order to regain your trust from 
now on."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby seemed to be reflecting 
deeply. I decided to put this matter 
behind us and look forward to what was to 
come.
